name: Mocha
caffeine: Mostly from the double espresso under the chocolate; treat it as a full coffee drink, never caffeine free.

house.ask: Not printed on our menus: ask at lineup whether there is an espresso machine, whether the bar will make a mocha, with which chocolate, and at what price.

what: A latte with chocolate: chocolate sauce or powder stirred into a hot double espresso, then steamed milk to fill an 8 to 12 oz cup. The milk runs a little wetter than a latte's, because the chocolate brings body of its own. Whipped cream goes on only if the bar does it.
taste: Sweet and rich, cocoa in front and coffee underneath, with a finish set by how bitter the chocolate is.

steps: Measure 0.75 to 1 oz chocolate sauce into a warmed cup and pull a double onto it.
Stir the chocolate into the hot shot until smooth, before any milk, or it sets at the bottom.
Steam 6 to 9.5 oz cold milk to latte texture, a little wetter; cut near 135 to 140F (57 to 60C).
Pour to the rim, add whipped cream only if the bar does, and send it at once.
make.ratio: 0.75 to 1 oz sauce to a double, milk to fill
make.dose: 18 to 20 g coffee; 0.75 to 1 oz sauce
make.cup: Warmed 8 to 12 oz cup or clear glass

serve: On a saucer with a teaspoon, out quickly because chocolate sinks. Late in the evening it is dessert in a cup, so offer it as dessert menus go down.
story: The name is a place, not a flavour. Mokha was the Yemeni port that shipped coffee for centuries, and its beans carried a cocoa note, so mocha meant coffee long before chocolate joined it. It sells to the guest who does not really like coffee.
guest: A latte with chocolate stirred into the espresso: sweet and rich, cocoa first and the coffee underneath.
watch: Chocolate added after the milk sets in the cup; stir it into the hot shot first.
Sauces differ widely in sugar; taste yours neat and set the dose to your cup.
It carries a double espresso's caffeine; never offer it as a hot chocolate.

recall.prompt: How is a mocha made, and in what order?
recall.answer: Chocolate sauce in a warmed 8 to 12 oz cup, a double pulled onto it and stirred smooth, then milk steamed a little wetter than a latte's, poured to the rim. Sweet, cocoa first.

quiz.q: The word mocha first named what?
quiz.explain: Mokha was the Yemeni port that shipped coffee with a cocoa note; chocolate joined the drink much later.

quiz.q: When does the chocolate go into a mocha?
options: Over the foam at the end
quiz.explain: Stir it into the hot espresso before the milk; added later, it sinks and sets in the cup.

quiz.q: Why is mocha milk steamed a little wetter than a latte's?
options: Wet milk hides a sour shot
Dry foam turns the cocoa bitter
quiz.explain: Chocolate thickens the drink, and a stiff cap sitting on sauce eats like pudding.
